achievements.name: First Partner
achievements.detail: Choose Grookey, Scorbunny, or Sobble and set out from Postwick.

achievements.name: First Catch
achievements.detail: Catch a wild Pokémon so it joins your team and appears in the Pokédex.

achievements.name: First Badge
achievements.detail: Defeat Milo at Turffield Stadium and earn the Grass Badge.

achievements.name: Eight Badges
achievements.detail: Beat all eight Galar gym leaders and collect every Gym Badge.

achievements.name: Dynamax
achievements.detail: Dynamax a Pokémon in battle so it towers over the field for a short time.

achievements.name: Max Raid
achievements.detail: Win a Max Raid Battle against a Dynamax Pokémon in the Wild Area.

achievements.name: Rotom Bike
achievements.detail: Ride the Rotom Bike to cross the Wild Area quickly.

achievements.name: Camp Curry
achievements.detail: Cook a curry for your team while resting at Pokémon Camp.

achievements.name: Galar Champion
achievements.detail: Win the Champion Cup by defeating Leon.

achievements.name: Zacian
achievements.detail: Catch Zacian, the legendary Pokémon of the sword.

achievements.name: Galar Pokédex
achievements.detail: Register every Pokémon listed in the Galar Pokédex.

achievements.name: Crisis Caught
achievements.detail: Catch the legendary fought during the story's last crisis.
